Bring 5 bespoke Nxeon marketing pages up to the site's gold-standard design, driven by buyer psychology. Work ONLY in `/opt/nxeon-wt-consist-c` (branch feature/consist-c). Commit + push when done. Do NOT run npm build/prisma — write code + `npx tsc --noEmit`.

## Gold standard (read first)
`app/page.tsx` (homepage) + `app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx` + `components/marketing/PricingExplorer.tsx`. Match their premium navy/violet/cyan glass look and REUSE the shared system: `components/marketing/primitives.tsx` (`PageHero`, `Section` size="lg", `SectionTitle` with real eyebrows, `Eyebrow`), `components/marketing/sections.tsx` (`SectionHeading`, `FeatureCard`, `CtaBand`, `TrustBadges`), CSS utils `.card`/`.card-hover`/`.lift`, `grad-text`, `.eyebrow(-pill)`, `hero-aura`, `tone-*`, `.btn-primary/.btn-secondary`, `AmbientField`, `Reveal` (stagger `delay={i*60}` ms). Geist font is already global.

## HARD RULES
- **KEEP ALL COPY, CLAIMS, STATS, and REVIEW elements verbatim** — DESIGN-ONLY. Do not delete/reword any headline, number, stat, or claim; do not remove/alter review content. Re-order/re-group/re-style only. No NEW invented stats.
- **Do NOT edit `components/marketing/sections.tsx`** (another agent owns it). If you want `CtaBand`/`FeatureCard`, import and use them AS-IS.
- **No VAT/pricing-logic work.** Prices stay DB-fed via existing queries; first-month-free hosting-only; no $0 cues elsewhere.
- No amber except semantic; motion-safe only.

## Buyer psychology
Strong above-the-fold (headline + value + primary CTA + trust row); anchor featured items with `.card lift … glow-brand`; social proof near CTAs; one clear primary action per section; scannable benefit-first; close with `CtaBand` (as-is).

## The work
1. **`app/(marketing)/v2/page.tsx`** — currently an off-theme superseded preview (own `bg-[#05070f]`, own `Eyebrow`, no `AmbientField`/`PageHero`). Rebuild it on the system (`bg-navy-950` via layout, `PageHero`, `Section`, `.eyebrow`, `AmbientField`) so it stops looking like a different site. KEEP its existing copy/stats (do not strip the numbers). It is `robots:{index:false}` — keep that.
2. **`app/(marketing)/compare/page.tsx`** — replace the inline `FeatureCard` reimplementation (~L180-186 icon tiles) with `<FeatureCard>`; align hero/sections to `PageHero`/`Section size=lg`/`SectionTitle` eyebrows. Keep all claims.
3. **`app/(marketing)/vibe-coding/page.tsx`** — the light-band cards (~L289-291 `border-black/10 bg-white/60`) should use the site's `.tone-light .card` treatment → `className="card"` inside the tone-light section. Align to primitives. Keep the terminal/editor mockups (intentional).
4. **`app/(marketing)/tools/page.tsx`** — REAL BUG at ~L133: `SectionTitle` has `eyebrow` and `title` set to the SAME string, so every category label prints twice. Give each a distinct kicker eyebrow (e.g. `eyebrow="Free tools"`) while keeping the title. Align sections to the system.
5. **`app/(marketing)/developers/page.tsx`** — align to `PageHero`/`Section`/`SectionTitle`. Fix BROKEN LINKS only (not claims): the `/docs` CTAs (~L99, L196) point at a retired public route — repoint to the correct docs location or remove the dead link (check where docs live now). Keep all copy/stats otherwise.

## Output
tsc clean (report it); commit + push to origin/feature/consist-c. Report per-page: new section order, primitives adopted, the tools double-title fix, the developers link fix, and confirm all original copy/claims/reviews kept + prices DB-fed. Previews on staging before going live.
